Proposition
[Monotonicity inside the injectivity radius] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0490, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0491, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0492 ↗ def:chow-iii-i28-sphere-maps 1. appi:1.29\group Distance spheres

If $\sect (g)\ge 0$ and $s\le t\le u<\inj (p)$, then \[ \dhat _{S(p,t)}(\varphi _{s,t}x,\varphi _{s,t}y) \le \frac ts\dhat _{S(p,s)}(x,y),\qquad \varphi _{t,u}\circ \varphi _{s,t}=\varphi _{s,u}. \]
Proof

\sketch The composition identity is immediate from the exponential definition. A Jacobi field $J$ with $J(0)=0$ satisfies Rauch comparison $|J(t)|/|J(s)|\le t/s$, and integrating this estimate along an intrinsic minimizing path on $S(p,s)$ gives the inequality.

□
